title: Customizations Entrypoint
description: Ticker. One row: "Customizations" with a description that cycles once through the types with their counts (84 Skills → 8 MCP Servers → 5 Agents …) when a new session opens, then settles on "Skills, MCP, Agents…". Hover pauses it; clicking the description while it cycles opens that type. Static under reduced motion. Zero extra sidebar space; motion buys attention without permanent noise.
